stem:
Read these sentences from paragraph 6.

Children can still run around at parks or make up fun games to play. Others can still relax under trees or in the grass on a nice day.

What is the most likely reason the author includes this imagery?

options.label: A
options.text: To introduce how visitors can help out with park tasks

options.label: B
options.text: To support how playgrounds encourage healthy park habits

options.label: C
options.text: To explain how parks are better suited for good weather

options.label: D
options.text: To show how people can enjoy the simple parts of a park
